seoTitle: Create a Survey in Smartsheet Using Forms
metaDescription: Build a public-facing survey in Smartsheet by structuring your intake grid, activating the Form builder, and adding conditional question logic.
intro: Smartsheet's Form builder turns a background spreadsheet into a real public-facing survey, complete with conditional logic and automated response tracking. This guide covers structuring your data columns, building the form, and setting up notifications for new submissions.

steps.heading: Set up your survey sheet
steps.body: Create a new master sheet and configure your data capture layout for the questions you plan to ask.

steps.heading: Define your column types
steps.body: Use Contact Lists, Dropdowns, Date fields, and Text areas to match each question's expected answer format.

steps.heading: Activate the Form builder
steps.body: Turn your background spreadsheet into a public-facing survey link using the native Smartsheet Form builder.

steps.heading: Add conditional logic
steps.body: Set rules to show or hide specific fields dynamically based on how a respondent answers earlier questions.

steps.heading: Customize branding and deploy
steps.body: Add company descriptions, mark required fields, format the thank-you screen, and share the survey via public link or embed code.

faq.question: Can I make a public survey link with Smartsheet?
faq.answer: Yes, the Form builder converts your spreadsheet into a shareable public-facing survey link.

faq.question: Can questions change based on previous answers?
faq.answer: Yes, conditional logic rules let you show or hide specific fields dynamically depending on earlier responses.

faq.question: Will I get notified when someone submits the survey?
faq.answer: Yes, automated workflows can be set up to notify your team instantly when a new response comes in.

faq.question: Can I embed the survey on a website instead of just sharing a link?
faq.answer: Yes, Smartsheet provides embed codes in addition to public links for deploying your survey.
